text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The Big Carrot Burger has come to<n>Japan!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, Trainer! Fancy goin' for a<n>burger with me?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
They've brought over one of my<n>favorite burgers
from back home!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's outta this world! First, there's the<n>giant patty,
practically overflowin'<n>with juices...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Then comes the sweet, buttery carrot<n>sauce on top!
I used to buy 'em with<n>my family all the time...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's why we gotta go together,<n>Trainer. 'Cause
you're my Japanese<n>family!
choice_data_list: You know we've got training soon, right?
You know we've got training soon, right?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly why we gotta go!<n>Munchin' on that
burger will give me<n>the strength to work hard!
Pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much, Trainer! Don't hold<n>back, now!
Eat your fill!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And afterward, let's give training our<n>all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh no... I can't believe they're closed<n>today...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I swear I looked it up andeverything... Boo.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We can get the burgers to go? I<n>didn't know that
was an option!

This way, we can avoid usin' up too<n>much training
time. Everything works<n>out!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You're just as smart as a whip,<n>Trainer. I tip my
hat to ya!
